Title: Director – Source to Pay Excellence - Dubai Holding Group Services
Description:
**About Dubai Holding Group Services:**

Group Services is Dubai Holding’s shared business services arm that provides consolidated business solutions in procurement, finance and human capital across the Group. With a commitment to talent, digital innovation and continuous improvement, it delivers best-in-class service, enhancing the Group's overall performance.

Group Services is dedicated to transforming operations, elevating service quality and cultivating specialised teams focused on excellence and innovation.

**Group Services comprises:**

Group Services Procurement delivers end-to-end value through strategic sourcing, supplier management, and contracting. Enabled by advanced technology, streamlined processes, strong governance, and data-driven insights, it ensures responsible sourcing, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.

Group Services Finance manages financial transactions, budgeting, and reporting to ensure strong fiscal health and cash flow. It empowers informed decision-making through insights that drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Group Services Human Capital manages the full employee lifecycle, ensuring a smooth journey from recruitment to offboarding while fostering a culture that values and supports people—the Group’s greatest asset.

**Empowering talent for the future:**

Group Services’ greatest strength lies in its people; their collective capabilities serve as the driving force of the company. Dedicated to creating a vibrant talent hub where challenging the norm leads to innovation, collaboration fuels creativity and caring for people and partners cultivates strong relationships, Group Services aims to build a foundation for sustained success.

As a business that views success as a shared journey and celebrates every achievement along the way, Group Services offers the opportunity to grow, develop skills and make a meaningful impact.

Dubai Holding Group Services proudly supports a diverse portfolio of companies, including:

* Dubai Holding Real Estate
* Dubai Holding Entertainment
* Dubai Holding Community Management
* Dubai Holding Land Estates
* Dubai Holding Hospitality
* Dubai Holding Investments
* Dubai Holding Asset Management

**About the Job:**

Dubai Holding Group Services is seeking a Director – Source to Pay Excellence to lead the enterprise-wide transformation of Source-to-Pay services across Dubai Holding. This is a senior leadership role with accountability for shaping the S2P transformation agenda, strengthening the operating model, improving end-to-end service performance and enabling technology-led ways of working across Procurement, Contracting, Vendor Management and Purchase-to-Pay.

The role requires a credible transformation leader who can operate at executive level, translate business priorities into practical delivery roadmaps, challenge current ways of working, and mobilise cross-functional stakeholders across Group Services, Dubai Holding verticals, DHIT, Procurement and Finance. The successful candidate will be expected to build a high-performing S2P Excellence capability and establish the foundations for measurable, sustainable value realisation.

**Key Role and Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Transformation Scope**

* Own the Source-to-Pay excellence agenda across Procurement, Contracting, Vendor Management, Supplier Enablement and Purchase-to-Pay, ensuring transformation priorities are aligned to business needs and Group Services strategic objectives.
* Assess current operating models, process performance, governance, system utilisation and customer pain points to identify material improvement opportunities.
* Develop practical transformation roadmaps, business cases and implementation plans that improve service quality, cycle time, compliance, user experience and value delivery.

**Delivery Leadership and Governance**

* Act as the senior figurehead for S2P transformation, providing direction, challenge and escalation support across complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Lead prioritisation of transformation opportunities using Voice of the Customer input, operational data, service metrics, risk indicators and strategic value potential.
* Manage approvals for key transformation documentation, including business requirements, design decisions, delivery milestones, stakeholder sign-offs and change readiness outputs.
* Partner with DHIT and technology suppliers to ensure system enhancements, Oracle Fusion optimisation and digital enablement initiatives are business-led, well governed and adoption-focused.

**Stakeholder, Change and Value Realisation**

* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Group Services, Dubai Holding verticals, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Risk, Compliance and IT.

* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, work orders and subcontractor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes and repair dispatches based on technician qualifications, geography and priority.
* Monitor technician productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, parts availability and client communication for incomplete repairs.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site maintenance schedules, dispatch priorities and travel logistics across assigned territories.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective repairs within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, outages and repair delays; keep the client informed.
* Track work-order status, technician assignments, service dates and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with labor, parts, test results, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate repeat service calls, incomplete repairs and workmanship concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of used oil, filters, coolant, batteries and other service waste.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, troubleshooting, load testing and repairs at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing field preventive maintenance and generator repair programs with testing and QA documentation.
* Parts and materials management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, service scopes and warranties.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs, generator diagnostics, emergency repairs and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for generator outages, emergency repairs and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion and work-order closeout.
* Repair quote, dispatch and service response within contract requirements.
* Every service visit documented with required inspections, test results and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator uptime, reduced repeat failures and timely resolution of deficiencies.
* Low repeat-repair rates, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator refurbishment and replenishment program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Mostly on-site at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: stock levels, refurbishment turnaround, fulfillment lead times and warranty claims.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every order’s required delivery date; flag at-risk orders early with a firm revised date.

**Assessment, refurbishment and remanufacturing**

* Oversee intake of decommissioned generators, ATS units and components.
* Direct repairability assessments and give the client written repair, refurbish or dispose recommendations.
* Schedule and oversee repair of whole units and components, including controllers, alternators, fuel systems, turbos, radiators, breakers, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Oversee ATS refurbishment: contactors, communication, transformer and relay boards, ribbon cables and enclosures.
* Enforce QA: functional testing, inspection reports, and serial-number and refurbishment-step records for every asset.
* Manage warranty claims and keep QA records for the full warranty period.
* Ensure refurbishment and disposal meet industry standards and environmental rules (fluids, batteries, scrap).
* Test incoming units promptly and log results in our inventory system.
* Send repair quotes for client approval; never repair or dispose of client equipment without written approval.
* Keep a detailed repair history for every repaired client-owned unit.
* Coordinate third-party repair shops (starters, alternators, controllers) where we don’t self-perform.
* Prepare purchase offers for non-functional equipment and manage the bill of sale process.

**Inventory management**

* Run secure, organized storage of client assets, with a preventive maintenance program for stored units.
* Keep minimum stock levels of critical components and plan replenishment against demand.
* Publish regular inventory reports: asset status, location and repair progress.
* Source parts and units through resale and secondary-market networks when stock runs short.
* Run inventory in our inventory system and give the client access and standard reporting through it.
* Build and maintain a demand planning method from usage, consumption and project data.
* Set and regularly review minimum spares levels with the client.
* Support client audits of client-owned equipment and keep required insurance current.

**Consignment and sales**

* Take in client equipment for consignment and bring it to working condition.
* Market consigned equipment, set sale prices within agreed limits, and track costs and fees.
* Remit proceeds, handle sales tax, and keep bills of sale in order.

**Logistics and order fulfillment**

* Manage nationwide transport, storage and preservation of assets, with handling and transit risk controls.
* Fulfill orders for refurbished and replacement units and parts to designated sites within agreed lead times.
* Run the escalation process for delays and keep the client informed.
* Track title and risk-of-loss transfer points on every shipment.
* Close out each order in our system with tracking and serial numbers sent to the client.
* Process dead-on-arrival returns and freight damage claims with proper documentation.
* Handle hazardous materials and disposal correctly, with disposal reporting to the client.

**Site services**

* Plan generator removal and replacement at tower sites with the client’s operations and construction teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing a repair, refurbishment or reverse-logistics operation with testing and QA documentation.
* Inventory management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, warranties, title and risk of loss.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with an inventory, ERP or work order system.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Background in aftermarket parts, remanufacturing or consignment and resale programs.
* Knowledge of EPA and DOT rules for fluids, batteries, hazardous materials and freight.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based mostly on-site at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours during storm response or urgent replacement orders.
* On-site visits involve warehouse and tower-site conditions: heat, noise, outdoor weather and PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time delivery and order closeout against required dates.
* Quote, order and testing turnaround within contract response times.
* Every unit and component tested, documented and serial-tracked.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Rising refurbishment yield and recovery value on non-functional equipment.
* Low warranty returns and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Title: Senior Manager, Specialty Operations (Remote)
Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Manager of Specialty Operations to support the operational execution of our new specialty product launch. This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

· Assist clients in accessing community-based resources.

· Provide resources and information to support safer substance use.

· Demonstrated leadership skills and experience working on a multidisciplinary team

**Job Overview:**

Chicago Fire Football Club is seeking a Senior Manager, Business Strategy & Analytics to help lead the day-to-day operations and execution of the Club's Business Strategy & Analytics function. This role will report to the Senior Director, Marketing and serve as a key partner across the organization, working closely with Ticketing, Corporate Partnerships, Soccer Business and Marketing to translate business priorities into actionable strategies, analytics, models and data-driven solutions.

This individual will operate as a player-coach, balancing team leadership and project management with hands-on analytical work. *Business Analytics & Modeling*

Identify opportunities to improve the team’s tools, methodologies, automation and overall technical capabilities.

* Serve as a strategic and analytical partner to stakeholders, helping determine how data, analytics, modeling and technology can support better decision making.

* Lead complex, cross-functional analytics and data projects, establishing clear ownership, scope, timelines and measures of success.

* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms, ideally Salesforce and/or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and an understanding of how customer and fan data can be activated to support business objectives.

Title: Head of Project Execution, C&I Energy
Description:
**About The Role**

We are looking for an experienced Head of Project Execution to lead project execution for Yellow Door Energy's commercial and industrial (C&I) portfolio across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Oman and Qatar. The role will ideally based in Saudi Arabia but we may consider Dubai.

Reporting to the Group COO, you will lead engineering and project management for our core C&I project portfolio across solar PV, BESS and grid-connected energy solutions. Your accountability will run from pre-construction design through construction and commissioning to handover to Operations & Maintenance. You will make sure projects are technically robust, safely delivered, commercially disciplined and aligned with approved investment assumptions.

This is a senior leadership role that operates at both strategic and technical level. It suits someone who combines proven C&I execution leadership with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS, electrical infrastructure and grid connection. You will build and lead a high-performing regional team and set the standards, governance and ways of working that shape how YDE engineers and delivers its projects.

**What You'll Deliver & Own**

**Team and execution leadership**

* Lead and develop the regional Execution team across engineering and project management, setting clear priorities, standards and accountabilities aligned with Group and country objectives.
* Build team capability through coaching, performance management, succession planning and recruitment as the portfolio grows.
* Lead senior engagement with clients, EPC contractors, consultants, suppliers and delivery partners, resolving material technical and execution issues.
* Work closely with Development, Commercial, Technical, Procurement and PMO, Finance, Legal, O&M and QHSSE to ensure execution requirements are reflected in project decisions and commitments.
* Embed consistent project governance, reporting, lessons learned and continuous improvement across the regional portfolio.

**Engineering, grid and pre-construction assurance**

* Provide technical leadership across pre-construction and detailed engineering, including design reviews, constructability, site suitability and optimisation.
* Lead or oversee technical negotiations with clients and EPC contractors, ensuring technical requirements are properly reflected in tender packages, EPC agreements and technical appendices. Support commercial negotiations where needed.
* Oversee grid connection and Grid Code compliance across LV, MV and HV systems, including SEC, SERA and SASO requirements and other applicable standards.
* Guide major equipment specification and selection, covering PV modules, inverters, BESS, transformers, switchgear, protection, cables, tracking systems and monitoring solutions.
* Ensure energy yield and performance assessments, including P50/P90 analysis and uncertainty evaluation, are robust and correctly reflected in project assumptions.

**Project delivery, construction and handover**

* Oversee delivery against investment committee-approved scope, budget, schedule and technical assumptions, intervening early where risk or variance emerges.
* Direct contractor and supplier performance, including technical coordination, design implementation, site progress, issue resolution and change management.
* Ensure effective QA/QC across factory acceptance testing, site inspections, mechanical completion, commissioning, PAC, FAC and end-of-warranty activities.
* Ensure as-built documentation, testing records, punch-list closure and handover requirements are complete for transition to O&M.
* Promote strong QHSSE performance and visible safety leadership across all execution activities.

**What You Must Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
* 10+ years' relevant experience in solar PV, renewable energy or power infrastructure, including at least 5 years in a senior management or leadership role within technical consulting, EPC, project execution, engineering or asset management.
* A track record of leading multidisciplinary engineering and project delivery teams across development, construction, commissioning and handover.
* Substantial experience in EPC contracting and negotiation, contractor management, technical due diligence and delivery governance for complex energy projects.
* Deep technical understanding of solar PV, BESS, grid connection and LV/MV/HV electrical infrastructure, including protection and major equipment selection.
* Sound knowledge of GCC grid and regulatory requirements, including experience working with local utilities and applicable Grid Codes.
* Commercial and contractual judgement to resolve complex technical, contractual and delivery issues.
* Experience working effectively in a multinational, matrix environment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.

**Strong Advantage**

* Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE).
* Hands-on familiarity with PVsyst and related design or simulation tools such as SolarGIS, AutoCAD, SketchUp, PVcase or HOMER.
* Experience across C&I, hybrid and/or utility-scale renewable energy projects.
* Exposure to M&A, project acquisition or technical due diligence.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You are equally comfortable in leadership discussions and in a detailed design or grid review.
* You can challenge designs, assumptions and delivery approaches while keeping relationships constructive.
* You build teams with clear expectations and accountability, and you invest in developing people.
* You spot execution risks early and resolve them with sound technical and commercial judgement.
* You look for ways to raise standards, strengthen governance and turn lessons learned into better delivery across a growing portfolio.

**Why Join Us?**

You will lead the execution of C&I renewable energy projects across four markets, working across solar PV, BESS and increasingly complex grid-connected energy solutions.

The role offers real influence over how YDE's projects are engineered and delivered. You will build the regional team, set delivery standards and work closely with YDE's regional leadership and Development, Commercial, Technical, Finance, Legal and Operations teams.

**About Yellow Door Energy**

Yellow Door Energy is the leading sustainable energy partner for commercial and industrial businesses across the Middle East and Africa. We deliver sustainable energy solutions through power purchase agreements and solar leases, helping businesses reduce energy costs, improve power reliability and lower carbon emissions.

Our solutions include solar PV, battery energy storage systems, hybrid energy and energy efficiency. Our shareholders include Actis, Mitsui & Co, TAEF and the International Finance Corporation.

**Apply Now!**

If you are an experienced renewable energy execution leader with deep technical knowledge of solar PV, BESS and grid-connected systems, and a track record of building teams that deliver safe, high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you.

**Let's lead the charge in sustainable energy solutions together.**

Title: Senior Program Manager
Description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services, delivering end-to-end solutions and service to clients across its global organization.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the strategic direction, integrated planning and end-to-end delivery performance of AXI within the Investor Relations Value Stream. In addition to the official Senior Program Manager title, the role fulfils the Value Stream Delivery Lead responsibilities for Investor Relations, ensuring that agreed outcomes and priorities are translated into a coherent roadmap, single governed backlog and measurable delivery plan.
  
  
As a member of the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, the role partners with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to connect strategy with execution. The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.
  
  
As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The role shapes delivery strategy, challenges constructively, resolves complex cross-functional constraints and represents the Value Stream in portfolio and executive forums. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.
* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.
* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.
* Drive consistent delivery practices, delivery metrics and continuous improvement while allowing teams to apply fit-for-purpose Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.
* Coordinate cross-Value Stream demand and dependencies, negotiate sequencing with shared services and escalate priority decisions where demand exceeds available capacity.
* Manage Value Stream capacity, resource demand and allocation, ensuring commitments are realistic and delivery constraints are visible early.
* Lead quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, execution reviews and delivery governance across strategic change, client work, business requests, platform change and KTLO activity.
* Maintain one visible and prioritized backlog linking Value Stream outcomes and objectives to executable epics, stories and delivery commitments, with clear ownership and no orphaned work.
* Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**
Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.
* Ensure program commitments are realistic and supported by sufficient capacity, funding, technical readiness and business ownership.
* Lead Value Stream prioritization and trade-off discussions where demand exceeds capacity or where scope, sequencing, cost, dependencies or risk require leadership or executive decision.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on delivery confidence, financial position, outcomes and material constraints.
* Ensure program delivery complies with applicable Project Management Department, PMO, SDLC, risk and control requirements

**Technology Delivery and Release Oversight**

* Oversee delivery across the SDLC, ensuring requirements, design, engineering, testing, UAT, performance, release and production-readiness activities are integrated and governed.
* Partner with product, business and technology leadership to maintain alignment between business outcomes, platform priorities and technical execution.
* Coordinate cross-platform, cross-program and cross-Value Stream dependencies, ensuring demand, blockers and integration risks are visible, owned, sequenced and resolved.
* Ensure releases have clear acceptance criteria, quality evidence, operational readiness, communications, implementation and support arrangements.
* Own the health of the Value Stream delivery system, using flow, quality, capacity and financial data to identify bottlenecks, remove impediments, improve predictability and support continuous improvement.
* Promote fit-for-purpose use of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches rather than applying a single methodology by default.

**Executive and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technology leaders, operations, control functions and external partners.
* Communicate complex delivery matters clearly and directly, adapting detail and recommendations to the audience.
* Present program status, risks, dependencies, investment choices and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums.
* Create a consistent program narrative across stakeholders and ensure decisions, commitments and accountabilities are understood and followed through.
* Challenge constructively where delivery confidence, scope, sequencing, ownership or expected value is unclear.
* Navigate competing priorities and organizational complexity while protecting agreed program outcomes.

**People Leadership and Project Management Capability**

* Provide formal line management for assigned staff within the Project Management Department, including regular one-to-ones, objective setting, performance and development conversations, and support for career growth.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, professional conduct, stakeholder management, governance and accountability.
* Allocate and balance work across direct reports, considering program priorities, individual capability, development needs and sustainable workload.
* Coach and mentor project and program management professionals, providing practical guidance on complex delivery situations and supporting sound judgement.
* Identify capability, capacity and succession needs within the team and contribute to recruitment, onboarding, talent development and retention.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable practices and knowledge-sharing across the Project Management Department and relevant communities of practice.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where staff receive timely feedback, understand priorities and are supported to perform effectively.

**Measures of Success**

* Investor Relations Value Stream priorities and AXI investment are translated into one realistic, governed and outcome-focused roadmap and backlog.
* Program commitments are delivered with clear ownership, executive visibility and effective financial control.
* Material risks and dependencies are identified early, with timely decisions and credible mitigation or recovery plans.
* Business, product and technology stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, sequencing, delivery confidence and expected outcomes.
* Releases are delivered with appropriate quality, operational readiness and production support.
* Project Management Department staff have clear objectives, balanced assignments, regular feedback and meaningful development support.
* The Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI delivery teams demonstrate improving flow, predictability, transparency, collaboration and measurable value.

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
**Essential**

* Extensive experience leading large, complex and strategically important technology programs across multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery execution, flow, planning, capacity, dependencies and governance within a Value Stream, product or comparable cross-functional operating model.
* Proven accountability for end-to-end program delivery, including strategy translation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, risk, dependency, quality and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, influence senior leaders and make sound decisions in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
* Strong experience coordinating delivery across business, product, engineering, architecture, testing, operations and control functions.
* Deep understanding of SDLC and delivery methods, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, with the judgement to tailor governance appropriately.
* Proven people-management experience, including objective setting, coaching, performance management, development planning, workload management and recruitment support.
* Experience leading and developing project or program management professionals across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and influencing capability.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.
* Ability to connect program outputs to business outcomes, adoption and measurable value realization.

Desirable
  
  
**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic and outcome-focused, while remaining close enough to execution to intervene effectively.
* Creible and composed with senior stakeholders in complex or high-stakes situations.
* Decisive, pragmatic and willing to make delivery issues visible.
* Strong ownership mindset with high personal accountability.
* Inclusive people leader who sets clear expectations and invests in the development of others.
* Collaborative and able to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Resilient, adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.

**Role Accountabilities**
The Senior Program Manager fulfils the Delivery Lead role for the Investor Relations Value Stream and owns delivery execution, flow, integrated planning, governance, financial control, dependencies and delivery performance for AXI. The Value Lead remains accountable for value, vision and priority decisions; the Technology Lead remains accountable for architecture, engineering quality and technical direction; and the Operations Lead remains accountable for operational input, readiness and adoption. The Senior Program Manager brings these perspectives together into one executable delivery system and is accountable for the effective line management and development of assigned Project Management Department staff.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
Your well-being is of paramount importance to us and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.
  
  
Citco recognizes diversity as a source of organizational pride and strength. Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities, and accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

**Scope:**

Senior Manager-Planning and Operations is accountable for the end-to-end planning, optimisation, delivery and performance of Transguard’s workforce transportation network. The role owns the integrated transport planning and operational delivery cycle, ensuring transport demand forecasts are translated into effective fleet, driver and route plans and successfully executed through operational teams. The position is responsible for maximizing the utilization, efficiency and performance of a transport network comprising approximately 700 vehicles supporting more than 45,000 daily passenger movements. This includes accountability for fleet deployment, driver utilisation, route optimisation, service delivery, customer performance, transport costs and operational productivity. The role leads planning analysts, transport supervisors and operational teams to ensure alignment between workforce demand, transport capacity and customer requirements. Through the use of AI-enabled planning tools, transport management systems, telematics, GPS technology and business intelligence platforms, the role establishes a closed-loop performance management process that continuously measures actual performance against planned outcomes, drives operational improvements, improves planning accuracy and delivers sustainable efficiency gains across the transport function.

**Responsibilities:**

**Financial**

* Accountable for the optimization and performance of a transport operation with an annual operating budget.
* Own fleet utilization, resource allocation and service efficiency to maximise value from transport assets and workforce resources.
* Drive route optimization, vehicle productivity and driver utilisation initiatives to reduce operating costs whilst maintaining agreed service levels.
* Lead the identification and delivery of cost reduction, cost avoidance and operational efficiency opportunities across the transport network.
* Establish performance measures and reporting frameworks to monitor transport costs, utilization, productivity and return on fleet investment.

**Customer**

* Accountable for the delivery of safe, reliable and efficient transportation services supporting more than 45,000 daily passenger movements across Transguard operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients to ensure transport services align with operational requirements, workforce deployment plans and contractual commitments.
* Establish customer service standards, performance metrics and service level agreements, ensuring transport performance consistently meets agreed expectations.
* Lead the resolution of service issues, operational escalations and customer concerns, implementing corrective actions to improve service reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Utilize customer feedback, operational performance data and service reviews to identify improvement opportunities and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Provide regular performance reporting and operational insights to business leaders, creating transparency and confidence in transport service delivery.

**Process**

* Accountable for the end-to-end transport planning and operational delivery model across all workforce transportation activities.
* Own the integrated planning cycle, ensuring transport demand forecasts are translated into executable vehicle, route and driver deployment plans.
* Lead planning, scheduling and operational delivery teams to ensure transport services are delivered in accordance with business requirements and customer commitments.
* Establish and govern planning standards, operating procedures and performance frameworks across transport operations.
* Accountable for fleet utilization, route efficiency, driver productivity and service performance across the transport network.
* Direct the deployment of vehicles, drivers and operational resources to maximize service reliability and operational efficiency.
* Establish structured performance reviews comparing planned versus actual outcomes and ensure corrective actions are implemented to address variances.
* Lead transport capacity planning, network design and resource planning activities to support future business growth and changing demand.
* Own business continuity, operational resilience and transport risk management frameworks.
* Develop governance processes that create continuous improvement between planning assumptions, operational outcomes and future transport plans.

**Innovation**

* Support the transport planning and delivery transformation roadmap through the adoption of AI-enabled planning, predictive analytics, automation and optimization technologies.
* Establish a data-driven transport operating model using telematics, GPS intelligence and business intelligence platforms.
* Develop automated performance reporting that provides visibility of utilization, productivity, operational efficiency and customer service outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning accuracy, improve operational performance and optimize asset utilization.
* Identify emerging transport technologies and support the development of business cases that improve efficiency, sustainability and customer experience.
* Create a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence by embedding performance feedback loops between planning and delivery teams.

**Selection Criteria:**

* Minimum 8-10 years' experience in large-scale transport, logistics, fleet or workforce mobility operations.
* Proven experience leading both transport planning and operational delivery functions within a complex, high-volume operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing transport management systems, telematics platforms, GPS technologies and business intelligence solutions.
* Strong track record in fleet optimization, route scheduling, capacity planning and operational productivity improvement.
* Experience leading large multidisciplinary teams and delivering measurable operational performance improvements.
* Strong analytical, commercial and data-driven decision-making capability.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and transport planning software.

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.

Title: Contact Center Manager
Description:
Trust is everything for financial institutions, but it gets harder to earn as customer expectations rise and fraud keeps evolving. At Casap, we’re on a mission to deliver outcomes that were once out of reach, building a future where fraud is rare and trust is a given.
  
  
We started with disputes, some of the highest-stakes work financial institutions can’t afford to get wrong, and have expanded the same approach across fraud, collections, claims and more. Today, more than 100 banks, credit unions, fintechs and processors trust our AI agents to make decisions, take actions, move money and file chargebacks, from first signal to final outcome.
  
  
Founded by product leaders from Robinhood and Chime, Casap has raised $90M, including a $56M Series B led by Base10 Partners with continued investment from Lightspeed and Emergence. We were named Tearsheet’s 2026 AI Company of the Year, and our CEO, Shanthi, was named to Inc.’s 2026 Female Founders 500. We have an exceptionally ambitious and kind culture, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Location(s)**
This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, CA office. Our team works in-office time on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Contact Center Manager to join our Managed Services team and oversee our BPO operations day to day. As Managed Services expands, our BPO engagement is the compliant, reliable entry point for every fintech and credit union client we support. You'll lead our outsourced contact center and back-office investigation teams, manage policies and procedures, optimize IVR routing and call scripts, and turn vendor partnerships into clear results for our clients.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own BPO Performance Day to Day: Serve as the primary operational contact for our contact center vendor(s). Manage SLA adherence, stand up performance reporting, run a regular vendor review cadence, and escalate underperformance with clear evidence and a path to resolution.
* Own IVR Design and Call Routing: Design, test, and optimize IVR flows and routing logic across vendor platforms. Reproduce routing issues, review call logs and data, and identify root cause before escalating to the vendor, engineering, or product.
* Own Scripting and Quality Standards: Partner with the QA/Performance Manager to build and maintain call scripts, quality standards, and calibration practices that keep every interaction compliant, consistent, and on-brand for each client.
* Partner on Workforce Management: Collaborate with WFM to align staffing, scheduling, and coverage planning with volume forecasts, and flag capacity risks before they affect clients.
* Own Security and Compliance for Phone Intake: Define and monitor controls for phone-based intake, including caller authentication and data handling. Audit the vendor against those controls and drive remediation of any gaps.
* Own Outcomes, Not Just Tickets: Treat recurring vendor or call-quality issues as programs to be solved. Define scope, align internal stakeholders and the vendor, and deliver durable resolutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Be the Bridge to Engineering and Product: Translate contact center and client friction into clear technical requirements and prioritized, business-context-rich input. Advocate for scalable solutions, including tooling integrations and automation.
* Optimize Contact Center Tooling: Partner with Managed Services Leadership on the integration and optimization of contact center platforms (e.g., TaskUs or equivalent).[C1]
* Support Client Relationships: Support the Vendor Ops Manager in client-facing work by providing performance data, preparing for business reviews, and connecting vendor results to each client’s operational goals.
* Drive Enablement and Documentation: Build the runbooks, escalation paths, and training materials that make the vendor self-sufficient and prevent repeat issues. Support the implementation team in standing up phone intake for new Managed Services clients.

**What You’ve Done**

* 4-7 years in contact center operations, vendor management, technical account management, or customer success, ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company serving financial institutions.
* Experience managing outsourced or in-house contact center operations at scale, ideally in a regulated industry, with hands-on IVR, WFM, and vendor SLA management.
* Experience in payments, disputes, chargebacks, or Reg E/Z compliance workflows, and familiarity with compliance requirements for phone-based financial services intake.
* A track record of turning vendor relationships into measurable, accountable performance.
* Ability to investigate issues independently: reviewing call data and logs, querying data, and identifying root cause before escalating.
* Strong relationship management skills, with the presence to build credibility with vendor leadership and with operational and executive stakeholders at clients.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: able to make a complex operational or dispute issue clear to both frontline teams and leadership, and to work closely with QA, Product, and vendor partners.
* Structured problem-solver with great composure when an issue is live and the stakes are high, comfortable building process while doing the work in an early-stage environment.

**Compensation**
The base pay range for this role is $80,000 – $100,000 per year.

We also offer exceptional benefits, as well as bonuses and commission plans for applicable roles. The listed US-based compensation range is a guideline and may be modified. Title: Carrier Certification Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Carrier Certification Manager will own Eagle's end-to-end carrier certification program across the US and Canada. This includes managing active certification projects, building and maintaining carrier relationships, and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales to ensure Eagle's modules achieve and maintain certification across all major networks. This role is essential to Eagle's product commercialization timeline and go-to-market readiness.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Manage active carrier certification programs across AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US), and Telus, Rogers, Bell (Canada), ensuring on-time completion.
* Serve as Eagle's primary point of contact with carrier certification teams and labs; build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier ecosystem managers.
* Coordinate pre-certification activities: lab selection, test plan development, sample preparation, and firmware readiness in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
* Own the certification project tracker and communicate progress, risks, and timelines to product management and executive leadership.
* Manage certification costs, budgets, and vendor relationships (third-party test labs, certification bodies).
* Oversee PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC, and ISED submissions that feed into carrier certification eligibility.
* Monitor carrier certification policy changes, new requirements, and network evolution (e.g., 5G Standalone, Network Slicing) and proactively update Eagle's certification strategy.
* Support the sales team by clearly communicating certification status and timelines for customer RFQs and design-in decisions.
* Develop and maintain certification documentation, including test reports and compliance records.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in carrier certification, regulatory compliance, or technical program management within the wireless, module, or device ecosystem.
* Direct experience managing AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile certification processes; Canadian carrier experience is a plus.
* Understanding of PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC certification frameworks and their interplay with carrier certification.
* Strong project management skills; ability to run multiple certification programs in parallel.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills with engineering, product, and sales stakeholders.
* Experience with cellular module certification specifically (as opposed to device/handset only).
* Familiarity with 5G NR certification requirements and how they differ from LTE.
* Knowledge of ISED (Canada), FirstNet, and MVNO certification requirements.
* Experience working with third-party test labs.
* Flexible to attend occasional early-morning or evening calls to coordinate with teams in Asia (UTC+8).
* Willing to travel occasionally to carrier or third-party laboratories to provide on-site support as needed.

**What We Offer**
**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

We are seeking an experienced Manager for strategic contracts. Metadata and Localization Lead, Global Product Delivery

This replacement role oversees metadata management, recurring program copy and FAST artwork requirements, and the operational coordination of dubbing, subtitling and metadata translation projects. This role also contributes to workflow optimization, systems integration and automation initiatives, particularly across Airtable and Blue Lucy.
  
This role will report to the Senior Manager, Content Operations, Global Product Delivery and is a hybrid position requiring in-office attendance at our head office in Toronto for a minimum of three (3) days per week.
  
The anticipated salary range for this role is $60,000 – $65,000 per year, with final compensation determined by experience and qualifications.
  
Core Responsibilities & Duties
  
Metadata Management and Operations
  

* Oversee the organization, accuracy, consistency and completeness of program metadata across FAST, VOD, SVOD, linear and other distribution platforms.
* Establish and maintain metadata standards, operational workflows and quality-control processes.
* Coordinate program metadata intake, maintenance, updates, translations and recurring platform requirements.
* Identify and resolve metadata discrepancies, missing information and operational gaps.
* Manage recurring metadata requirements for platform launches, monthly refresh schedules and ongoing catalogue updates.
* Coordinate program copy, descriptions, FAST artwork and associated metadata requirements, including submitting recurring requests to Creative and other relevant teams through established workflows.
* Support new platform metadata setups, specification changes and template development, ensuring requirements are incorporated into existing workflows.
* Support the centralization and migration of legacy metadata into established systems and repositories.

Localization Operations and Vendor Coordination

* Review monthly FAST and linear refresh schedules to identify upcoming localization requirements and prepare for recurring deliveries.
* Maintain localization trackers, language-version records, vendor quotations, production statuses and associated documentation.
* Coordinate localization requests with approved vendors, ensuring requirements, specifications, source materials and deadlines are communicated accurately and on time.
* Work closely with Content Deliveries, Media Services and relevant internal teams to ensure source files are made available to localization vendors.
* Monitor production progress, follow up on outstanding deliverables and escalate potential delays, quality concerns or operational issues.
* Update localization trackers and relevant systems upon receipt of completed language assets, maintaining accurate records of delivered materials.
* Reconcile vendor invoices against approved quotations, agreed rates, completed deliveries and final production costs, resolving discrepancies and routing validated invoices for approval.
* Provide operational support for localization proof-of-concept (PoC) projects, including AI-assisted localization workflows and new vendor evaluations.
* Coordinate sample preparation, testing, feedback collection and documentation of results to support technology and vendor assessments.

Systems Integration and Workflow Optimization
