Title: Program Controls Advisory Services Manager
Description:
When you care deeply about the work you do, it’s rewarding to see it through from concept to completion. We partner with clients to provide both program management and construction management to strategize, plan, and implement projects that drive organizations forward. From hospitals and airports to university campuses, mass transit systems, water treatment facilities, mines, and wind farms, we've successfully managed thousands of projects.

Joining our team, turning visionary ideas into reality, will shape your future—and the future of your community.

We are strategizing, planning, and implementing projects that help clients achieve their organization’s objectives. Join our award-winning program management team and bring transformational project solutions to life.

Your Opportunity

Stantec is seeking qualified candidates for a Program Controls Advisory Services Manager position. The individual serves as a senior advisor to major capital programs, providing strategic Program Controls leadership during program mobilization, execution, transformation and periods of performance challenge.

The role operates at the intersection of client needs, Program Management and Program Controls, translating client objectives into practical governance, processes, systems, reporting and decision-making frameworks. Unlike a traditional Program Controls Manager focused on day-to-day delivery for one program, this role is deployed where specialized leadership, independent perspective or intervention is required.

The position establishes new controls organizations, assesses and strengthens existing programs, resolves complex delivery issues, improves underperforming controls environments and supports program leadership in restoring confidence, integration and predictability. It also acts as a trusted bridge among the client, PMO, delivery partners, consultants, contractors and internal controls teams.

This position requires prior experience working on an integrated program team with strong knowledge and hands-on experience in developing baseline project budgets and schedules; monitoring and tracking the progress of project work relative to established budgets and schedules; preparation of project budget and schedule status reports and presentations; working with Program/Project Managers to proactively identify project budget and schedule problems and implement corrective actions; and preparation of cost accruals, estimates to complete and estimates at completion.

Qualified candidates understand the process of administering the non-technical elements of large projects that are tied together for the successful delivery of a program. They are comfortable developing and maintaining procedures that help streamline project controls processes and provide mentorship to other project controls specialists and team members. They possess emotional intelligence and prioritize establishing and maintaining trusting relationships and close partnerships with Program/Project Managers, other team members and supporting them in serving the client and meeting established goals to achieve success

Your Key Responsibilities

Program Mobilization and Setup

* Advise clients and program leadership on fit-for-purpose Program Controls operating models for major capital programs.
* Develop governance frameworks for cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting, funding, performance measurement and reporting.
* Establish integrated WBS, CBS, OBS, control accounts, coding structures, baselines, calendars, reporting cycles, roles, responsibilities and approval authorities.
* Develop Program Controls Plans, procedures, SOPs, workflows, responsibility matrices and reporting standards.
* Evaluate and recommend PMIS, scheduling, cost, risk and business-intelligence solutions, including Primavera P6, Primavera Unifier, e-Builder, Power BI and enterprise ERP platforms.
* Create scalable controls that mature across planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and closeout.

Program Controls Advisory

* Serve as a senior advisor to Program Directors, Program Managers, PMO leaders and client executives on program performance and controls strategy.
* Independently assess whether controls are producing reliable information that management can use with confidence.
* Translate complex controls data into executive-level insight on current status, forecast direction, changes, risks and required decisions.
* Challenge ineffective practices and recommend practical improvements aligned with program maturity, complexity, risk profile, contracting strategy and delivery model.

Program Intervention and Issue Resolution

* Rapidly assess controls maturity and identify root causes of performance issues.
* Evaluate schedule quality, cost performance, forecast reliability, risk exposure, change governance, funding alignment and reporting effectiveness.
* Identify breakdowns among cost, schedule, risk, change, funding, contracts and program decision-making.
* Develop and lead targeted recovery and corrective-action plans with clear owners, milestones and performance indicators.
* Resolve unclear ownership, inconsistent processes, disconnected data, reporting gaps and ineffective functional interfaces.
* Stabilize underperforming controls environments and remain engaged long enough to embed sustainable improvements.

Client Services and Client Advocacy

* Serve as a trusted advisor between the client and the program delivery organization.
* Understand client objectives, funding constraints, governance requirements, risk tolerance and performance expectations.
* Translate client needs into clear, actionable requirements for the PMO and delivery teams.
* Facilitate difficult conversations involving performance, forecast changes, schedule delays, risk exposure, funding constraints and delivery challenges.
* Provide an objective perspective where client expectations and delivery realities are not aligned.
* Build trust through transparent, data-driven advice while maintaining productive stakeholder relationships.

Program Performance and Integration

Promote an integrated management environment in which Scope -> Schedule -> Cost -> Funding -> Risk -> Change -> Forecast -> Decision operate as a connected system.

* Ensure cost forecasts reflect schedule progression, approved changes and known risks.
* Ensure schedule forecasts consider procurement, funding, contractor capacity and delivery constraints.
* Connect quantified risk exposure with contingency and management reserve strategies.
* Improve consistency between project-level and program-level reporting.
* Develop forward-looking indicators that identify emerging issues before they become significant performance problems.

Governance and Program Assurance

* Conduct health checks and maturity assessments of Program Controls organizations.
* Assess compliance with procedures and governance expectations, including gaps between documented and actual practices.
* Establish escalation thresholds, decision rights and approval authorities.
* Support executive governance forums with concise, decision-oriented performance information.
* Review data quality and reporting reliability before information is elevated to client executives.
* Support independent program reviews, recovery initiatives and performance-improvement efforts.

Leadership and Capability Building

* Mentor Program Controls Managers and professionals across cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting and reporting disciplines.
* Coach program leadership on using controls information for timely decisions.
* Establish clear interfaces among PMO leadership, controls functions, delivery teams and clients.
* Build collaborative multidisciplinary teams and reduce functional silos.
* Develop repeatable standards, frameworks, templates and leading practices for deployment across programs.
* Plan knowledge transfer so improvements remain with the program after the advisory engagement ends.

Typical Engagements

* A new multi-year capital program needs its controls organization established.
* A PMO is being formed, reorganized or transitioned.
* A client needs an independent assessment of Program Controls.
* Forecasts or schedules are not credible, consistent or decision-ready.
* Projects report differently, preventing program-level visibility.
* Risk, contingency, funding and change are disconnected from cost and schedule.
* Leadership does not trust dashboards or performance reporting.
* Systems are fragmented, overly complex or underutilized.
* Client and Program Management expectations have become misaligned.
* A program requires stabilization, turnaround, recovery or knowledge transfer.

The successful candidate should:

* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Have the demonstrated ability to encourage and facilitate collaboration and cooperation amongst diverse team members
* Schedule and lead coordination meetings
* Work in a manner to ensure personal safety and that of fellow employees by following company health and safety guidelines and policies.
* Consistently adhere to Company processes and policies including business conduct, cyber-security, safety and personal conduct.

It is expected the successful candidate will have the following qualifications:

* Combination of a degree from an accredited institution in an applicable field or documented experience specific to program controls
* BA/BS Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Finance, Project Management or a related discipline.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred
* Additional certifications, PgMP, PMI-SP, PMI-RMP, PMI-CP, CPA, CCM, PE, FE, or similar certifications is preferred
* A minimum of 15 years’ progressive experience supporting complex capital programs, including substantial Program/Project Controls leadership experience infrastructure/buildings/utility/water programs is required
* Familiarity with various project delivery methods, including Design Bid Build, Progressive Design Build, CMAR, and Design Build.
* Demonstrated success establishing, transforming or leading Program Controls functions on major infrastructure or capital programs.
* Strong knowledge of cost management, forecasting, scheduling, risk and opportunity management, change management, funding and cash-flow planning, performance reporting, PMIS/ERP environments and program assurance.
* Experience in the municipal sector in areas of public works, utilities, transportation, and industry and on multi-sector programs is preferred
* Experience in owner, PMCM, consultant, contractor or integrated delivery environments and advising senior client leadership.
* Must be able to demonstrate good interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Must demonstrate organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

Title: Operations Manager
Description:
**Operations Manager**  
Eastern North Carolina | Full time, salaried | $45,000 to $55,000 plus bonus and company vehicle

**About the role**

A privately held company is building a group of small businesses in eastern North Carolina, starting with established passenger transportation operations that have served their communities for years. The owner is looking for one person to lead day-to-day operations across two locations and to grow into a senior role as the company expands.

You will have a steady team, a clear set of responsibilities, and an owner who wants your input and will invest in you. This is a chance to get in at the start with a growing company, run something that matters to the people it serves, and build a career instead of just holding a job.

**What you will do**

*Lead the team*

* Manage a team of drivers and office staff at two locations about an hour apart
* Own the daily schedule and make sure every trip is covered
* Hire, train and develop people, and build a team that others want to join
* Keep records, licenses and required paperwork current and accurate

*Keep the fleet in good shape*

* Start each day by making sure the vehicles are ready to go
* Take care of simple fixes yourself (batteries, bulbs, tires, fluids, lifts and securements) and send the rest to the shop
* Manage the maintenance schedule and the relationships with outside mechanics

*Work directly with the owner*

* Be the owner's trusted partner on site, with a direct line and a real say in how things are run
* Lead projects that improve the business: vendors, insurance, facilities, equipment, new systems
* Keep things organized and moving so decisions turn into results

*Grow with the company*

* Help bring new locations and new businesses into the group
* Build simple, repeatable ways of doing things that work at more than one site

**What you bring**

* Three or more years leading people in transportation, fleet, logistics, field service, the military or a similar hands-on operation
* Mechanical ability. You do not need to be a mechanic, but you can spot a basic vehicle problem and fix the simple ones

Title: Guest Operations Manager
Description:
**About the Blank Family of Businesses:**

Arthur Blank is the Chairman and Owner of the Blank Family of Businesses and Co-Founder of The Home Depot, the world’s largest home improvement retailer and second largest retailer in the United States. Arthur’s family of businesses portfolio includes The Arthur M. Blank Family Foundation, National Football League’s Atlanta Falcons, Mercedes-Benz Stadium, PGA TOUR Superstore, Major League Soccer’s Atlanta United FC, and AMB West. While diverse in nature with unique operations and customers, all of these businesses are run based on a common set of core values, which focus on developing customer relationships, treating Associates with respect and supporting communities.

**About AMB West:**

We believe that Montana’s unique ability to connect people to each other and to nature has the power to build stronger, healthier, happier communities, and that we have a role in preserving Montana’s beauty for future generations. Like all the businesses within the Blank Family of Businesses, AMB West is a highly purpose-driven organization devoted to positively impacting the lives of its guests. AMB West consists of Mountain Sky Guest Ranch, West Creek Ranch, Paradise Valley Ranch, and Auster at Dome Mountain. In addition to these exceptional properties, there are additional plans for continued growth which will exponentially increase the positive impact on the Paradise Valley region.

**Auster at Dome Mountain**: Auster at Dome Mountain is the newest project from the AMB West team — a hospitality venture coming to life in the heart of the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem. This property with riverfront acreage will be open to the public and operational year-round. Currently in development, the project will include 20 cabins, a restaurant and bar, a small coffee shop, and a seasonal outdoor pool. With opportunities for outdoor education, recreation, wildlife watching, and winter exploration, the ranch is designed to offer all guests an immersive experience whether they are stopping by for lunch or staying for a week.

**Who we are:**

We use our core values as a compass to guide our decisions because they are our North Star. If we live our core values daily, we know everything else will take care of itself. We enjoy a culture rooted in giving back to others through our time, talents, labor, and financial commitment. We are successful when we collaborate with and value each other like family, maintain a hunger to delight guests and continuously innovate, listen closely for even the smallest need for improvement, stand up for convictions, and genuinely own our responsibilities.

**Our Ideal Candidates:**

Actively Listen – Take an active role in listening by being present in the moment, using healthy body language, and ensuring joint understanding. When we read between the lines and hear what others are saying and what they are not saying, we encounter amazing opportunities to go the extra mile in serving them.

Collaborate – Realize that we are better together than we are alone. We achieve much better results when others have the opportunity to add their diverse perspectives. Be open to feedback and actively seek input from a variety of people at varying levels because the best ideas come from those who are closest to those we serve.

Engage in Servant Leadership – Put others ahead of yourself even when it’s difficult. Find opportunities to lead by example in the way you pitch in and help others. Giving back to others is at the heart of what we do.

Build Relationships – Cultivate trust in relationships by showing respect and sensitivity. Invest time in helping others to continuously improve by listening to their ideas and helping them to continuously improve.

Own Results – Own issues you encounter even when they are outside of your area of responsibility by taking action or seeking out the needed resolution. You are empowered and expected to take risks aimed at exceeding the expectations of our guests. Take advantage of this rare opportunity by utilizing available resources.

**Position Summary**

Auster at Dome Mountain is seeking a hands-on, service-driven Guest Operations Manager to lead daily guest operations across the property. This role coordinates front office, activities, housekeeping, retail, and facilities to deliver a consistent and thoughtful guest experience. The Guest Operations Manager works closely with the General Manager and department managers, remains visible in the operation, and helps teams respond quickly and effectively to guest and business needs.

This is an operational leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between planning, team support, guest interaction, and real-time problem-solving. The ideal candidate brings strong hospitality judgment, clear communication, sound organization, and a willingness to work alongside the team when needed.

**General Responsibilities**

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Support property leadership in the management of daily operations at Auster at Dome Mountain.
* Coordinate guest-facing operations across lodging, front office, guest services, activities, housekeeping, and shared public spaces.
* Maintain a visible leadership presence and help ensure teams are prepared for arrivals, departures, activities, special events, and changing guest needs.
* Serve scheduled Manager on Duty shifts, providing property-wide leadership, supporting guest needs, coordinating operational response, and escalating issues when appropriate.
* Promote consistent service standards and ensure guest concerns are addressed promptly, thoughtfully, and to resolution.
* Lead from the front by supporting departments during high-volume periods and working alongside associates when operational needs require it.
* Facilitate clear communication between departments, including daily priorities, guest preferences, operational adjustments, and follow-up items.
* Support schedules and staffing plans to align coverage with occupancy, service demands, and property events.
* Provide accurate scheduling and time-away information for payroll processing, including sick time, unpaid time, vacation, and other approved leave.
* Participate in operational meetings and communicate decisions, expectations, and action items to the appropriate teams.
* Live out the Blank Family of Businesses core values: Listen & Respond, Include Everyone, Put People First, Give Back to Others, Lead by Example, and Innovate Continuously.

**Guest Experience**

* Help deliver a welcoming, personal, and consistent experience from pre-arrival through departure.
* Review daily guest information and coordinate with teams to anticipate preferences, special occasions, accessibility needs, and service opportunities.
* Serve as a point of escalation for guest concerns and partner with department leaders to identify appropriate solutions.
* Engage with guests throughout the property and gather feedback that can be used to improve service and operations.
* Support guest programming, property events, and other experiences as needed.

**Team Leadership**

* Coach, support, and hold teams accountable to service, conduct, safety, and operational expectations.
* Partner with department managers to establish daily priorities and follow through on commitments.
* Create an environment where associates have the information, tools, and support needed to perform their work effectively.
* Provide timely feedback, recognize strong performance, and address concerns in partnership with property leadership and Human Resources.
* Support onboarding and training so associates understand the property, service expectations, emergency procedures, and their role in the overall guest experience.
* Promote teamwork and respectful communication across departments.

This leadership role will oversee the project planning, communication, and execution of clinical research and development services offered by Everest. Direct reports include all levels and roles within the Project Management department, including Associate Directors, Senior Managers, Managers, Senior Project Managers, Project Managers, Associate Project Managers and Project Coordinators. In-direct reports/subordinates are those Project Managers who are assigned to the tasks on the client studies and projects overseen by the Director of Project Management (matrixed organization).

Title: Call Center Operations Manager
Description:
**About BlinkRx:**

BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that.

We built RxOS, the first AI-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script.

Our teams solve complex, high-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out-of-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month.

BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80+ billion category, with exceptional momentum:

* **Built for scale:**
  Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale.
* **Proven growth and economics:**
  We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands.
* **Trusted with category-defining programs:**
  Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer’s direct-to-patient platform for its GLP-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows.

We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health.

**The Role:**
The Patient Services Operations team is at the forefront of the company mission to bring affordable prices and deliver the best possible experience for all of our customers. As a Call Center Operations Manager, you won't just oversee a team — you'll set the pace, raise the bar, and build a culture where grit and customer obsession are the standard, not the exception. This is a high-intensity, high-impact role. You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution: designing systems that scale, coaching talent that sticks, and using data to drive relentless improvement. When things break — and in a fast-growing company, things break — you'll be the one who figures it out and moves the team forward. You'll collaborate across product, engineering, pharmacy, and business leadership to translate the voice of the customer into real operational and product changes. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a distance.

***This is a full-time, on-site position based in our Pittsburgh (Robinson Twp.) office.***

**What you’ll do:**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of customer service reps and team leads — holding the bar high while investing in each person's growth.
* Drive a performance culture built on accountability, candid feedback, and real development — not just annual reviews.
* Create an environment where people do their best work, feel ownership over outcomes, and genuinely care about the patients they serve.

**Operational Management**

* Own the day-to-day: ensure timely, high-quality resolution of customer issues across all channels (phone, email, chat) — at speed and at scale.
* Tackle complex, ambiguous escalations head-on with sound judgment and customer-first instincts.
* Build and enforce policies, processes, and SLAs that are rigorous but human — protecting the customer experience while enabling a fast-moving team.
* Stay ahead of capacity: monitor workload, adjust staffing, and anticipate surges before they become fires.

**Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Own the metrics that matter — CSAT, NPS, FCR, response time, resolution time — and use them to tell a story, not just report numbers.
* Surface trends in customer behavior and pain points; turn those insights into action with product, engineering, and operations.
* Implement Quality Assurance programs that raise the floor on service quality, every week.

**Process Improvement**

* Relentlessly question the status quo: identify friction in workflows, eliminate steps that slow agents down, and reduce customer effort at every touchpoint.
* Lead improvement initiatives end-to-end — design, pilot, measure, iterate.
* Bring the customer's voice to cross-functional teams, ensuring it shapes product decisions and business strategy.

**Technology & Tools**

* Evaluate, implement, and optimize CRM, ticketing, and support tooling — with a bias toward automation and efficiency.
* Partner with engineering and vendor teams to push system enhancements that keep our support infrastructure ahead of our growth curve.
* Treat data integrity as non-negotiable: if the data isn't clean, the decisions aren't sound.

**A successful applicant will fit the following criteria:**

We want someone who runs toward hard things. You'll thrive here if:

* You have 5+ years of leadership experience in fast-paced, high-volume customer service or call center environments.
* You have 2+ years in customer service, healthcare, pharmacy, or a related field — you understand the stakes when a patient can't get their medication.
* You're a builder of teams and systems — not just a manager of tasks.
* You use data instinctively: you know which metrics to watch, how to find the story in the numbers, and how to translate insights into action.
* You thrive in ambiguity. When priorities shift (and they will), you recalibrate fast and keep the team grounded.
* You communicate with clarity and conviction — up, down, and across the org — and you do it with respect and patience.
* You have a low ego and a high standard. You'll do whatever it takes, including jumping on the phones when the team needs it.
* Spanish bilingual is preferred — for supporting diverse customers and teams.
* You have a bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, or equivalent real-world experience.

**Why Join Us:**
It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

Under direction, manages and directs work operations relating to the intake and processing of 3-1-1 non-emergency calls received by the 311 City Services Center.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Directs supervisory level staff responsible for the intake and processing of non-emergency 3-1-1 calls from residents requesting city services or inquiring about city programs and events
* Develops and implements policies and procedures to ensure the effectiveness and efficiency of daily work operations
* Provides guidance to supervisory staff in handling complex calls and service requests
* Directs and monitors the preparation of daily work schedules and assignments to ensure optimal use of available staff
* Coordinates work efforts with city departments to ensure current and accurate information regarding city programs and services is available to staff and provided to the public
* Works with staff to resolve problems relating to the timely processing of requests for city services
* Provides directives to supervisors in notifying callers of special events or specific incidents, such as power outages and weather emergencies
* Oversees the development and implementation of training programs for operational staff
* Directs the unit’s administrative work operations including the maintenance of work records, preparation of productivity reports and the evaluation of staff performance including administering disciplinary actions as required
* Works with supervisors and consultants on issues relating to computer system and telephone equipment used by staff
* Monitors call volume and operational performance
* Analyzes data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement
* Supports the implementation of operational improvements, special projects, and initiatives designed to enhance employee performance, customer service, and overall efficiency of 311 operations

*Additional duties may be required for this position.*

**THIS POSITION IS EXEMPT FROM THE CAREER SERVICE.**

------------------

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Five (5) years of *supervisory* experience in customer service, dispatch, or non-emergency communications

***Ideal candidates will possess:***

* Strong leadership, organizational, problem-solving, decision-making, analytical, and interpersonal skills
* Previous supervisory experience in 311 Operations with the City of Chicago **OR** previous experience as a supervisor in a non-emergency call center or emergency call center in a major United States municipality
* Proficiency in Salesforce and NICE inContact software applications
